decisive_items: CT and MRI of the head revealed a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in the right axilla, anterior mediastinum, left pleura, and liver, consistent with cT4dN3M1 stage IV breast cancer
Biopsy showed invasive ductal carcinoma (no special type), high grade, ER+, PgR–, HER2 3+, Ki67 70%
response.rationale: A discrete brain mass in a patient with stage IV HER2-positive breast cancer is most consistent with brain metastasis; trastuzumab-related neurotoxicity would not produce a focal 30-mm intracranial mass lesion.

rejected.why: No evidence that trastuzumab causes a focal brain mass; the headache and temporal lobe lesion are better explained by metastatic disease in the setting of known stage IV breast cancer.
